opening.argument: The title and transcript identify a government-associated broadcast of a religious ground-breaking ceremony in Ayodhya: “PM Narendra Modi Attends Bhoomi Pujan Ceremony of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi in Ayodhya | Ram temple,” while the transcript states that “Prime Minister Narendra Modi will perform the ground worship.” The visible setting supports that account, with a flower-decorated shrine, saffron-robed attendees, and a speaker at a lectern. The description’s request to subscribe to PIB India is ordinary channel engagement, not a request for money, investment participation, data submission, or a deceptive benefit.
